sense: a plan diagram a house is seeded from
definition: A canonical plan diagram a house is seeded from: which rooms, which walls face outside, and what connects to what — and nothing else. Sizes come from the room records, scaled to the brief. Each descends from something actually built.
basis: schema/parti.schema.json: "A canonical plan diagram, used as a seed." It specifies topology and roles and nothing else; "Dimensions come from the room catalogue and are scaled to the brief", and "Every parti here is descended from something that was actually built". VISION.md: "a grouping is a phrase, a parti is a sentence pattern, a plan is a sentence."
analogy: A sentence pattern: a room is a word, a grouping a phrase, and a plan the finished sentence.
more: Each parti says what it trades away, because every diagram gives something up, and how it grows: most by widening rooms, some only by adding a link.
